standard_prerequisites.name: The regular-model situation, contractions of exceptional curves and pullbacks of Cartier divisors
standard_prerequisites.statement: The situation fixes a discrete valuation ring, a smooth projective curve over its fraction field, a regular proper model and the components of the special fibre with their multiplicities; an exceptional curve of the first kind is a smooth rational curve of self-intersection minus one and it may be contracted, the contraction being projective and keeping the surface regular and projective. For an effective Cartier divisor on a regular surface the pullback under such a contraction is computed component by component, the blowup case being recorded in the Divisors chapter, and the degree of a divisor on a component is invariant under the contraction for components disjoint from the contracted one. The author's own lemmas of the chapter and the quoted results of the Resolution of Surfaces, Divisors and Varieties chapters are the allowed inputs.
standard_prerequisites.use: The counted lemma is the computational core of the section on blowing down exceptional curves: it says that contracting a minus-one curve leaves the numerical type of the other components unchanged, which is what makes the contraction step of the classification of models work.

core_obligations: Produce the contraction: the chapter's contraction theorem gives a morphism contracting the chosen exceptional curve such that the target is again regular and projective over the ring, so the target satisfies the hypotheses of the situation, in particular it is a regular proper model of the same curve (source lines 5642-5648).

Identify the components of the new special fibre: the images of the other components are again irreducible and distinct, the multiplicities are unchanged, and the new special fibre is their sum, which is the first assertion together with the displayed list of data (source lines 5648-5660).

Compute the new intersection numbers: the pullback of the special fibre of the target is the sum of the special fibre and the appropriate multiple of the contracted curve, and passing to degrees along a component disjoint from the contracted one gives the displayed formula for the new intersection numbers (source lines 5660-5680).

Control the residue fields: for a component meeting the contracted one, the two residue field extensions factor over the residue field of the contracted curve, which yields the displayed pair of maps; the degree invariance under the birational pullback is what makes the computation above work (source lines 5680-5688).

proof_roadmap.step: Contract the exceptional curve and note that the target satisfies the situation.
Identify the components of the new special fibre and confirm the multiplicities.
Compute the new intersection numbers through the pullback computation.
Factor the residue field extensions for components meeting the contracted curve.

difficulty_reason: 计数单元是 Stacks Project 章 models.tex 的 Lemma lemma-blowdown-regular-model（源 5623-5639 行，证明 5641-5688 行，48 行）：设 C_n 是第一类例外曲线、f:X→X′ 为其收缩，则 X′ 与 C′_i、m′_i=m_i 仍构成 Situation 中的正则模型，且 (C′_i·C′_j) = (C_i·C_j) − (C_i·C_n)(C_j·C_n)/(C_n·C_n)（i,j<n），并对与 C_n 相交的分支给出残域关系 κ_i ← κ′_i → κ_n。关键操作不是例行核验：证明先用本章收缩定理把 X′ 仍是正则射影模型这一点落实（5642-5648 行），再确认其余分支在 f 下的像仍互异、重数不变（5648-5660 行），随后必须**沿 f 拉回并比较除子**才能得到新的相交数公式（用到 blowing up 的 Cartier 拉回与有效除子的和分解，5660-5680 行），最后对相交分支处理残域塔（5680-5688 行）。难点在于新自交数的公式要用「拉回下的次数不变性」精确地把 −(C_i·C_n)(C_j·C_n)/(C_n·C_n) 这一修正项算出来；原文位置在证明的 5642-5648、5648-5660、5660-5680、5680-5688 行。
